summary.text: Will Stapp is a Republican member of the Alaska House of Representatives for District 32, serving since 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to the Alaska Legislature's member page, Stapp served in the U.S. Army infantry from 2006 to 2010, including two tours in Iraq, and has lived in Fairbanks since 2011.
In Stapp's statement on the page, Stapp says the Purple Heart was awarded after being wounded and that Stapp works as an insurance agent specializing in employee benefits.
